title: How Buddhism Spread
dek: Of how a wandering teacher's order crossed Asia by winning kings and merchants, and why it grew rich enough for an emperor to seize.

panels.label: Monks Tell It
panels.text: The truth of the Dharma persuaded kings and peoples wherever it was preached.

panels.label: Evidence Allows
panels.text: Buddhism traveled with royal patrons and trade. Patronage made the monasteries rich, and wealth made them a target.

panels.label: The Tour
panels.text: 9 stops on the Chronosphere globe, from Bodh Gaya to Chang'an.
